title: Ipswich-O 2022
text:
The final event in our Ipswich-O 2022 series took place in Holywells Park today and the results can be downloaded from the website.

We're hoping to to welcome some of our Ipswich-O "graduates" to our other Summer events at Clare and Needham Lake - entry will be free if you have a signed Ipswich-O 2022 Passport 🙂

There are also MapRun events which may be of interest, particularly the one in Chantry Park - see our Events page for the dates.
